title: Strawberry Apple Fruit Bars No Added Sugar

details.description: Naturo Strawberry Apple Fruit Bars are made from real fruit ingredients, offering a fruity and convenient snack option. Crafted with apple juice concentrate, apple pulp, and strawberry puree, these bars combine the natural flavours of apple and strawberry in a soft, delicious format. Each pack contains four individually wrapped fruit bars, making them easy to carry and enjoy anytime. Made with 98% fruit-based ingredients, these bars contain no added sugar and are a convenient choice for on-the-go snacking.
details.ingredients:
Apple Juice Concentrate 48%, Apple Pulp 42%, Strawberry
Puree 8%, Thickener (Pectin), Lemon Juice Concentrate, Colour (INS 163 (vi)),
Added Flavour (Natural Flavouring Substance - Strawberry).
Contains: Permitted Natural Colour.
details.manufacturerName: Naturo Food and Fruit Products Pvt
details.storageInstructions: Store in a cool, dry place away from heat and sunlight.
